propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers in acli_graph.py (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) have no test coverage beyond a single page despite using opaque cursor pagination at page_size=100.
The readers terminate on either isLast flag or null/absent nextPageToken, but no test independently validates both stop conditions in isolation or asserts cursor advancement across requests.
A server returning repeated non-null nextPageToken tokens causes the readers to spin forever without a same-token-twice guard; the fail-open exception handler converts this to silent partial maps.

The test module validates that all 250 seeded items are recovered across 3 pages, that short-page responses do not prematurely terminate the walk, and that both stop conditions work independently via mutation testing.
An AST guard prevents future unpaginated whole-project readers from being added silently to adapters/jira by scanning for POST calls to /rest/api/3/search/jql without nextPageToken loop references.
